title: Plan European White Flowers signed byte projection
platforms: European ROM; Wine disassembly and static source plan
changes: Identify a signed-byte reader sequence and 48 non-overlapping source bytes covering three sampled offsets.
validation: Wine disassemblies o1ejpxi9 and qvbss5me and protected source plan g28z8ftk fingerprint the reader, root owner, cursor helper and selected bytes.
limitations: The read occurs before cursor normalization; preserve fallback for initial indices outside the projection. Controlled original-reader/helper proof, asset extent, ancestry, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
